== Notes ==
* [[Sword]]s with a [[Vampiric]] mod, [[Hundred Blades]], [[Order of the Vampire]], [[Conjure Flame]]/[[Conjure Frost|Frost]]/[[Conjure Lightning|Lightning]], etc. synergize well with Sun and Moon Slash because the effect triggers twice.
* Unlike [[Dual attack]]s, both attacks from this skill hit simultaneously, meaning both hits will connect even through skills such as [[Shield Bash]] or [[Shield of Judgment]].
